About Organization

The Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) is a government organization responsible for conducting various recruitment exams in the state of Uttar Pradesh.

The organization aims to provide employment opportunities to eligible candidates in various government departments.

About the Programme

The UPSSSC Livestock Extension Officer recruitment programme aims to fill 1251 vacancies in the livestock extension department.

The programme is designed to provide employment opportunities to eligible candidates who have passed the UPSSSC PET 2025 exam and have a diploma in livestock extension.
